description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Grand Rapids-Holland market (PTF-GRAND-RAPIDS-CENSUS-PIN-AND-RELEASE-CONTRACT-024). It describes only this market's reviewed authority and grants no deployment authorization.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is structurally consistent and safe to publish as a static bundle. It is not a deployment authorization and it makes no claim that the market is complete -- 114 of its 163 confirmed identities remain unresolved.

identity_census.note: The pinned census is the Grand Rapids-Holland identity universe, promoted from the 163-row recensus by PTF-GRAND-RAPIDS-CENSUS-PIN-AND-RELEASE-CONTRACT-024. It supersedes the 120-identity census the 2025 build pinned, which is kept at identity_census/superseded/. Ten prior identities are absent because each was absorbed into a fresh sighting of the same building on a shared street identity; every absorption is recorded.

reconciliation.note: Counts are derived from the pinned census, the committed policy package and this market's exclusion shard; unresolved is not negative pet evidence.

policy_package.note: The committed Grand Rapids-Holland policy package is the sole identity authority for its 35 verified profiles; no hard-coded allow-list is repeated here.
policy_package.schema_note: Schema 1.3; each record retains its founder decision binding and the semantic-approval hash it was signed against.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every unresolved census identity, the Budgetel identity hold, both halves of each open same-switchboard pair and avid hotel Zeeland have no seed row and no public route.

market_visibility.note: enabled by PTF-GRAND-RAPIDS-SOURCE-PROMOTION-022; this contract records the state rather than setting it

routes.note: Routes are derived from the 35 live records and the committed corridor assignment; unresolved identities are absent.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
